# Covers for the remaining example groups, and one tile cover per group

## Context

A card without a cover is not shown (#21124), and the overview of #21140 shows one tile per group. Three leaves produce covers: #20679 (Grid & Table, with the capture script), #21120 (Components) and #21121 (Forms, Multi-Window, Calendar, Scheduler, Gantt). A leaf of #21140, for the Engine 14 cut on Mon 23 Nov.

## The Problem

- No leaf owns the covers of Tree, Tab Container, Containers & Layouts, Dashboard & Docking, Buttons/Menus/Toolbars, Lists & Galleries, Dialogs & Overlays, Charts/Canvas/Maps, State & Data, Functional Components and Workers & Platform. Their groups cannot publish.
- No group has a tile cover. In [the first look](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21130#issuecomment-6918809237) the tiles were crops of whole-window frames, and both readers named the result: "the thumbnails are texture, not proof", and "next to the app cards they look like toys". Light and dark frames were mixed.

## The Architectural Reality

- #20679's capture script: one recipe per record (route, state, region, device scale).
- The cover rule measured on #21121: text on a cover reads at 0.64 of its size or more; a slice reads as a widget, a whole example as an application; a cut label reads as broken.
- A group tile is about 213 px wide at 1440×900 and 171 px on a phone (the sketch of #21130).
- Most of these examples build on the configuration viewport; once its first slice is on dev, the stage is one capture rect for all of them.

## The Fix

1. **A recipe per record** of the groups above, added to #20679's script: the component in a telling state, at a scale where its text reads on a 445 px card.
2. **One tile cover per group:** the group's one feature, readable at 213 px, in the dark theme. Gantt bars with a dependency, a tree with open branches, a calendar with events.
3. The design seat reads each sheet before review.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every published record of the groups above has a cover made by a recipe in the script.
- [ ] Each of the bound groups has a tile cover, named by the group's definition.
- [ ] All tile covers are captured in one theme, and no tile shows an empty state or placeholder text.
- [ ] The design read of each sheet is on this ticket before the pull request asks for review.
- [ ] **Look:** the overview's first screen with the tile covers beside the first look's frame; two readers without session context grade the unlabelled pair.

## Out of Scope

The covers of #20679, #21120 and #21121; records; the examples' own content.

## Avoided Traps

- **Whole-window shots of the configuration viewport.** They are white pages with a small component.
- **Capturing before the workbench's first slice lands.** Every such cover would be re-shot. If that slice misses Thu 19 Nov, capture by region from today's viewport and say so.

## Related

Parent #21140 · #20679 (the script; blocks this) · the workbench's first slice (its stage is the capture rect) · #21120, #21121 · #21119.

### @neo-opus-ada - 2026-11-18T03:15:40Z

**Intake: accept and sharpen** · read at `dev` `74238ddcc5`

- **Ready.** The only blocker, #20679, is closed. `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` and `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` own the concern (prescription checked): recipes and records only, no script change.
- **A tile is a record's cover.** #21241 put the group cards in the example cards' grid (`minmax(min(100%, 410px), 1fr)` in `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css`, about 560 px at 1440, as Grace and Vega settled on #21121), so the sketch's 213 px is gone. A group card shows its `tile` record's cover, else its first card's (`MainContainerController#publishGroups`). A tile cover is therefore that record's 640×360 recipe cover, and the work is recipes plus `tile` names.
- **Who covers which record**, after #21162 regrouped the catalog:

| Group | Records on `dev` | Cover |
|---|---|---|
| Containers & Layouts | `layout-form` | here |
| Dashboard & Docking | `dock-layouts`, `dock-cross-window`, `dock-tear-out` | here |
| | `dock-choreography` | #21121 (Grace's read: re-shoot) |
| Lists & Galleries | `helix`, `gallery`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery` | here (#21120 counted them while they were `components`) |
| Workers & Platform | `offscreen-canvas` | here (same) |
| Tab Container · State & Data · Dialogs & Overlays | `tab-container` · `state-provider` · `dialog-drag-drop` | #21121 (re-shoot) |
| Tree · Buttons · Charts · Functional | none yet | arrive with #20694, #21105 and #21145 |

- **Order.** Each shot follows the slate's Wednesday row, as #21121 runs it: keep is shot this week, renew by its renew leaf, retire gets no cover.
- **Two groups do not publish at all:** Timeline (`timeline-basic`: #21248 fixed its bars and left the cover) and Kanban Board (`board-basic`: no `tile` named, and the slate's renew row 2 has no leaf). They are Engine 14's new families, and no leaf owns their covers. I split them into a leaf of their own so that they land before Friday's read.
- **For the design seat: "all tile covers in one theme" cannot be met by recipes.** A recipe's `theme` sets the browser's color scheme, and only the Portal reads it (`Neo.config.prefersDarkTheme` in `apps/portal/view/ViewportController.mjs`). An example opens in the first theme its `neo-config.json` lists. `grid-tree-big-data` is dark because `examples/grid/treeBigData` lists `neo-theme-dark` first; board, timeline, scheduler and Gantt list `neo-theme-neo-light` first (checked at 1280×720 with the dark scheme emulated: board and timeline open light). (A) One theme for every tile means changing which theme the tile examples open in, which changes what a visitor gets. (B) The criterion goes, and each tile shows its example as it opens. I recommend B: #20679's frame rule asks for the example's own surface, and a dark cover of an example that opens light promises a look the visitor does not get. The two new tiles are shot as their examples open.

*Corrected 03:18Z: this bullet first recommended shooting every tile dark. That assumed a recipe's `theme` switches an example's theme. It does not.*

Ticket reality: filed 11-16, pre-stale. The surface changed since then (#21162, #21241), and the table above absorbs that.
